qa_history.answer: The user supplied the intended story instead of a yes/no answer, indicating that the assistant's guess was incomplete.

assistant_final_guess: The woman used to sleep with her head resting on her boyfriend's arm. After they broke up, she missed having his arm as her pillow so much that she attacked him and cut it off. She then carried his severed arm in her luggage, genuinely treating it as her 'pillow.' Security discovered the human arm and arrested her.
user_revealed_solution: The man the girl loved betrayed her today; he was packing his bags, preparing to move out of the apartment they shared. The girl tearfully begged him not to leave, but he didn't look back. Just then, the girl said coldly, "At least leave my pillow behind." And so, she cut off the boy's hand.

post_game_assessment.assessment: The assistant recovered the central twist that the 'pillow' was a body part of the ex-boyfriend and that the woman cut it off because she wanted to keep it as her pillow after the breakup. However, it guessed an arm rather than a hand and missed the betrayal, his plan to move out, her plea for him to stay, and the line 'At least leave my pillow behind.'
post_game_assessment.question_efficiency: Poor: 83 game questions were asked, with many repetitive questions about the pillow's physical position and role in the stabbing.
